title: Drug-Role-Stratified Disproportionality Analysis of Australian Antivenoms and Tropical Medicines in the TGA DAEN — Analysis Code
description: Reproducibility code for a READUS-PV 2024-compliant disproportionality analysis of the TGA Database of Adverse Event Notifications (DAEN) for Australian antivenoms (8 products) and a tropical-medicine basket (7 products). Includes data acquisition, cleaning, PRR/ROR/IC/EBGM computation, drug-role stratification, PELT change-point detection, sensitivity analyses, and clinical face-validity review.
